privacyBody: Stored on this device. No accounts, cloud, or tracking.
heroDescription: Search the moments on your screen, then return to what mattered.
searchPlaceholder: Search what was on your screen…
storedLocally: Screenshots and text are stored locally on your device.
dragToHour: Drag to jump to an hour
timelineEmptyHint: Start local capture to build a private visual history.
hourEmptyHint: Drag the slider to explore another hour.
spotlightNoMatches: No matches yet. Try a window title or text you saw.
spotlightInstructions: Type to find a screenshot. Use ↑ ↓ and Enter to open it.
copyHint: Select a highlighted text region to copy that line.
noRecognizedText: No text was recognized in this frame.
assistantDescription: Answers use local screenshots and a model running in Ollama.
assistantWelcome: What would you like to find?
assistantExample: Try “What was I working on today between 10 AM and 12 PM?”
askPlaceholder: Ask about what you saw or worked on…
noModels: No Ollama models are installed. Install a model in Ollama to start chatting.
startServices: Start Local Recall and Ollama, then retry.
intervalHelp: Screens are checked on this device at this interval.
ignoredHelp: Comma-separated process names. Password managers are always ignored.
settingsDescription: Control how Local Recall records your screen.
appearanceDescription: Choose the look and language that feel right.
serviceUnavailable: Local service is unavailable. Start Local Recall again to reconnect.
